messages:
jordan: Heads-up — I opened a Terraform change that moves GPU pool egress to a dedicated NAT EIP for better billing isolation. Can someone eyeball for networking / security impact before I schedule a merge window? PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/ml-infra/merge/942
jordan: This is mostly small: add nat_eip resource, update route table on the gpu-subnet, and a couple of tag changes. Plan shows 1 create, 1 update.
```hcl
# excerpt from plan
+ aws_eip.gpu_nat_eip
~ aws_route.gpu_subnet_route (config change)
```

jordan: Targeting a merge sometime tomorrow morning (US-PST) if no objections. Needs at least one infra review + security ack.
taylor: @jordan can you paste the plan output lines around the route update? want to confirm there's no accidental route replacement for prod-gpu-subnet.
jordan: added the relevant plan snippet above. Route update is just adding the eip allocation-id to the nat gateway reference, not replacing the subnet resource.
maria: quick question — does this change affect fx-dedicated cluster that's used for testing? will the eip allocation push a quota risk? :thinking:
jordan: good call. I checked quotas — we have room for one more EIP in the region. fx-dedicated references a different NAT, so no overlap.
alex: I can take a look now. kicking off a local plan to reproduce. If CI passes and no route deletion shown, happy to approve. :+1:
devops-bot: CI pipeline started for merge request 942 — terraform plan: running
alex: saw a lint nit (missing lifecycle prevent_destroy on the eip). filing a one-line suggestion in the PR, won't block merge if you want me to approve after that
sam: approve from my side for networking impact. verified no controls are overridden. :thumbsup:
jordan: thanks all. alex — if you can approve after your suggestion I’ll hold off merging until 09:00 PST tomorrow and then land during the low-traffic window.
alex: will re-run plan after you push the suggested lifecycle block and approve if plan still shows only create/update.
devops-bot: terraform plan complete — no destructive changes detected (1 to add, 1 to change, 0 to destroy)
alex: looks clean, approved the PR.
jordan: merging at 09:05 PST tomorrow unless anyone raises a blocker before then. Thanks everyone!
